coach_verdict: Focus on Priority 1 today: a solid Zone 2 aerobic engine builder on the bike. Your CTL is too low and your recent consistency is too poor to justify high-intensity intervals right now. Lay down a reliable aerobic base to kickstart your progression safely.

priority_1.workout_details: 60 minutes continuous cycling keeping power strictly between 150W and 193W (Zone 2). Maintain a cadence of 85-95 RPM.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority. Your aerobic baseline needs consistent volume and frequency. Zone 2 work aligns directly with the 70/30 pyramidal rule and safely builds your mitochondrial density without spiking fatigue.

priority_2.workout_details: 30 minutes continuous conversational running. Focus on a smooth cadence (165-175 SPM) and relaxed upper body posture.
priority_2.reason: Second priority if you prefer running over cycling today. Directly supports your 5km running goal by focusing on aerobic efficiency and musculoskeletal resilience without excessive impact stress.

priority_3.workout_details: Squats: 3 sets of 5 reps (RPE 7); Romanian Deadlifts: 3 sets of 8 reps; Plank variations and weighted core work: 3 sets of 45 seconds.
priority_3.reason: Third priority. Integrates gym work to support cycling torque and running power while addressing core stability. Use this if your legs feel heavy from daily life, but prioritize aerobic work if fresh.
